cases.note: #_snapshot_# counts only as the first line of a part (or the second, after a comment): later in a part it is an unrecognized marker, and every part is read.
Only a comment may precede #_snapshot_#: after a marker line it is ignored.
#_snapshot_# takes no value: with one it is an unrecognized marker.

A snapshot part in the restating form of 19.8 reads as the store does, whether a reader starts at it or replays the parts before it: a deletes a, the defaults and fill-empty are reset, and b keeps its place.

#_return_defaults_when_missing_#	true
#_rotate_#	keep

cases.note: A reader that skips history starts at the last snapshot part. These parts break 19.10.2a on purpose (part 2 does not restate a or b), so that the skip shows.
A reader that does not implement 19.10 ignores #_snapshot_# and replays every part (the same parts as the case above).
